log.text: M15 iBO buy: a candle closed above 4143.31 (an internal break: the pages enter it with the same BO, VR, CF).
M5 VR: the first BO Structure (QM) against the BO. The VR runs 4143.74 to 4149.90; its extreme 4149.90 is the target.
M5 CF: the BO Structure (QM) back with the BO, after the pullback reached 50% of the range (4140.04). The CF zone is 4135.96 to 4146.52, inside the VR: the kind that often fails.
Price pulled back into the CF zone and an EG closed with the BO: buy 4146.51, stop 4142.06 ($0.30 past the pullback's extreme, risk $4.45), target 4149.90 (0.8R).
M15 barrier: a fresh demand zone 4122.16 to 4140.39, the origin of an internal BO buy.

Price left the barrier and came back to it (visit 7). Its confirmation is read on M5 (the second table's M5, besides the first table's M1). The barrier is AGAINST the H1 direction (sell): the method expects only a rejection from it.
M5 CF: a QM (BO Structure) buy, a candle closed above 4146.52. A buy limit rests at that level for the pullback.

Price pulled back to the level: buy 4146.52, stop 4138.24 ($0.30 past the extreme 4138.55 made at the barrier, risk $8.28), target 4171.36 (3R: the replay's own choice, the method names no fixed target here).
M15 barrier: a fresh supply zone 1.32450 to 1.32666, the origin of a BO sell.
Price left the barrier and came back to it (visit 4). Its confirmation is read on M1. The barrier is with the H1 direction (sell).
M1 CF: a QM (BO Structure) sell, a candle closed below 1.32476. A sell limit rests at that level for the pullback.

Price pulled back to the level: sell 1.32476, stop 1.32510 (0.00010 past the extreme 1.32500 made at the barrier, risk 0.00034), target 1.32374 (3R: the replay's own choice, the method names no fixed target here).
